title: Commit Queue Intent
description: One machine-local commit-queue intent file at .agent/state/collaboration/commit-queue/<intent-id>.json. Commit queues are machine-local ephemera by owner ruling (2026-08-17, rulings ledger row QUEUE-LOCAL): never in version control (the collaboration-state ignore file covers the directory), one JSON file per intent like the comms event store, a 1-hour TTL measured from updated_at, expired files swept lazily by queue writes and treated as absent by reads.
$comment_compatibility: Extracted from active-claims.schema.json $defs/intent_to_commit at the 1.4.0 registry split (the registry's commit_queue array moved to this per-intent store). The filename is <intent_id>.json; readers reject a file whose name disagrees with its intent_id. expires_at is stored for view parity and always derives as updated_at plus exactly the 1-hour TTL.

intent_id.description: Unique identifier for this queued commit intent; also the file's basename. Lowercase-only (the pattern, not the case-insensitive uuid format, is what enforces it — mirroring agent_id.id): the id IS the filename, so an uppercase variant aliases the lowercase file on a case-insensitive filesystem, silently replacing a live peer's intent and then failing every read of the directory against the store's filename/id equality check.

claim_id.description: Active claim this queue entry belongs to.

agent_id.$comment_provenance: Per PDR-027 agent identity as amended by PDR-076a: intents require the UUID v5 id (every live writer emits it via collaborationAgentIdWriteSchema; the read boundary enforces the same shape).
agent_id.description: Identity of the agent that queued this intent. The routing key is (agent_name, id).

agent_name.description: Persistent descriptive name for this agent on this thread.

platform.description: Platform identifier: claude-code, cursor, codex, gemini, etc.

session_id_prefix.description: First 6 characters of the PDR-027 seed (the untagged platform session id on cloud seats; the harness session id otherwise); 'unknown' if not exposed.

id.description: PDR-076a deterministic UUID v5 derived from the stable session seed; the canonical routing disambiguator.

naming_schema_version.description: Name provenance: the registered naming-schema era that derived agent_name, or 'override' for operator-specified names.

files.description: Repository-relative file paths the agent intends to stage.

commit_subject.description: Draft commit subject so peers can see the intended durable history label before it lands.

updated_at.description: Refreshed by the owning agent on commit-queue phase changes. The TTL clock: the entry expires exactly one hour after this timestamp.

expires_at.description: Derived view-parity timestamp: always updated_at plus the 1-hour TTL. Reads treat a file past this moment as absent; queue writes sweep it.

phase.description: Advisory lifecycle phase. Successful commits remove their intent file rather than preserving phase=complete.

queued_seq.description: Queue order key: the store's SOLE ordering field, carrying the arrival order the pre-1.4.0 flat array expressed as its element position. Assigned under the claims-file transaction lock as max-over-LIVE-entries + 1, so values are REUSED as the queue drains — correct for relative order, and never a global counter or an identity. queued_at cannot serve: two agents enqueueing inside one millisecond tie, and breaking that tie on intent_id hands the queue to whoever drew the lower random UUID.

staged_bundle_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint over git diff --cached --name-status and git diff --cached --full-index --binary.

staged_name_status.description: Recorded git diff --cached --name-status output for staged-bundle inspection.

notes.description: Optional free-form coordination note for this queued commit intent.
